title: One Call Does It All
description: Learn how to write a macro that keeps re-triggering itself down the file, until it runs out of lines.

success.content:
TITLE - list
alpha v2-fixed

charlie v2-fixed - end of list

objective: The title line gets its own one-off fix.
Every entry below it needs its number stripped, its version bumped, and a 'fixed' marker appended — record that once, and let a single call handle every remaining entry on its own.
Once they're all fixed, put them in order and mark the last one as the end of the list.
